SETUP: bead calibration (docs/BEAD_CALIBRATION.md), after the spray work. Clean up the silicone; EMPTY or DISCONNECT the silicone line (the traverse moves 0.5 mm per capture so the auto-trigger fires) and HOME the traverse first (21.5 mm of nudges in all). Move the nozzle out of the way as needed, but do NOT touch the camera, lens (focus ring, aperture), its distance or the backlight. Exposure 4 us (after the exposure series). Camera tab: Run AI analysis OFF, Window check OFF, Auto-trigger ON. Mount the MIXED sandwich (all five sizes, coverslip towards the camera) square to the camera at the spray plane.
